scope: Batch 11A of 11H: five original, source-linked champion fight-decision profiles. Editorial interpretation only, not independently measured combat or reproduced source-kit text.

sources.title: Kabam v59.0 release notes — Spider-Man Noir Crumble interaction fix

decisions.title: Apply Exhaustion before using a power-control Special
decisions.text: Spider-Man 2099 can apply Exhaustion with a safe Heavy and Physical Vulnerability through SP1. Read the current debuffs and opponent's power before treating the follow-up SP2 as a fully prepared control window.

decisions.title: Use SP2 Wither against a real Power Gain threat
decisions.text: SP2 can offer Wither while its burst benefits from unique personal debuffs. A defender immune to Wither or whose power comes from an unmodified node may require another counter rather than an assumed complete shutdown.

decisions.title: Extend debuff uptime through eligible dodges
decisions.text: A successful dash-back dodge and prevented-buff interactions can help maintain pressure. Track the remaining effects instead of backdashing into a corner simply to refresh a timer; SP3 Slow is a separate long-fight choice.

decisions.title: Follow the visible Clue before accumulating Cruelty
decisions.text: Spider-Man Noir develops Dormant Cruelty from completing specified Clue actions. Check the current on-screen task, since using a generic combo may not earn the resource needed for the intended SP2.

decisions.title: Use second Lights to establish Disorient safely
decisions.text: Repeated eligible Light attacks can develop Disorient, but the defender may resist ability-accuracy reduction. Choose safe openings and verify the effect before relying on it to disable a dangerous defensive trigger.

decisions.title: Cash Crumble into a deliberate block-pressure window
decisions.text: SP2 can convert Cruelty and introduce Crumble, after which hitting block can create a Rooted follow-up. This requires a live Crumble state and the correct attack rhythm; the October patch also addressed an Evade-prevention issue, so avoid old bug claims.

decisions.title: Build Crowd Members without feeding unsafe Specials
decisions.text: Spider-Punk can gain crowd through successful defensive Special dodges and a punish. Select a defender whose Special can be safely avoided; do not repeatedly bait a dangerous attack solely to increase the audience count.

decisions.title: Practice SP2 chord input before expecting the full Rupture setup
decisions.text: His SP2 rewards correctly timed rhythm inputs that develop Rupture and crowd. A missed input changes the result, and Rupture immunity can erase the damage plan; choose a manageable opening before spending two bars.

decisions.title: Use SP1 while Ruptures have time remaining
decisions.text: SP1 can capitalize on active Rupture pressure, while SP3 offers longer-fight duration improvement. Check the timer and remaining defender health rather than holding power until the setup expires.

decisions.title: Complete the current Headline before changing objectives
decisions.text: Spider-Slayer uses a displayed Headline that can require specific actions. Read it before committing; a safe Heavy can reroll an unsuitable task, but forcing that Heavy while the defender can counterattack is not a good trade.

decisions.title: Use the camera only from protected spacing
decisions.text: The hold-block and upward-swipe camera interaction can develop a Falter and Fury opening. Confirm the resulting state and any anti-Miss protection instead of assuming the defender's next hit will always miss.

decisions.title: Spend Specials before the defender reaches an unsafe power state
decisions.text: His Specials can produce Power Burn under relevant enemy-power conditions. Watch the defender's current bar and avoid keeping them at maximum power merely to increase a potential payoff.

decisions.title: Develop Fury before deciding how to spend it
decisions.text: Spider-Woman can build Fury through basics and SP2, but the stack count and remaining time matter. Choose a safe attacking window rather than spending SP1 before any useful buff is present.

decisions.title: Refresh Fury with an eligible dodge, not a risky guess
decisions.text: Correctly dodging a Special or using an available Evade can help maintain Fury. Check the defender's anti-Evade tools and the active timer before assuming repeated defensive movement sustains damage indefinitely.

decisions.title: Use SP1 Sting and Shock pressure when the defender can receive it
decisions.text: SP1 can convert offensive buffs into Shock and Power Sting opportunities. Check whether the relevant effects landed before baiting another enemy Special; Shock immunity or effect cleansing changes the intended burst.
